sections.title: What is a Spotter?
sections.content: A Spotter is a ground-level observer who feeds real-time intelligence to the Cathedral. Spotters are the eyes and ears on the ground – they see what the sensors miss.

sections.title: How to Spot
sections.content: Watch for unusual activity, disruptions, or early signs of crisis. Report via the UNDP demo or Signal. Include location, time, and description.

sections.title: Safety Guidelines
sections.content: Never put yourself at risk. Report only what you can observe safely. The Cathedral warns the vulnerable – but your safety comes first.
